I am just a small boy helping my family on our millet plot here in the North West. We do not have much money, so I will use the manure from our goats and sheep like my father does, and maybe a little fertilizer if we can get it from the agro-dealer when the rains start. We will plant our own seeds we saved from last year, and my mother, father, and I will do most of the work ourselves on this small plot.
